name: TextEditor
summary: A bounded rich-text editor with a portable Mux document value.

obligations: Expose the accessible name, descriptions, required, disabled, read-only, and invalid state on the editable content.
Expose toolbar button names and pressed state.
Keep the editable region keyboard operable.
Expose the color popup as a dialog with a labelled custom color field.

behavior: A finite document value is controlled or internally managed.

A document contains blocks only: paragraphs and headings contain inline text and hard breaks; lists contain nonempty list-item sequences beginning with a paragraph; block quotes contain nonempty block sequences; code blocks contain plain text; horizontal rules and images are atomic blocks.
Safe marks preserve bold, italic, underline, strike, code, links, colors, font families, and font sizes.
The simple toolbar renders Bold, Italic, Underline, Color, alignment, and Bullet list controls with separators; advanced adds font selects, Link, Image, and Generate with AI.
Color opens a 16-swatch popup with a custom hex ColorField.
Image requests a durable http(s) image URL when no onImageRequest callback is supplied; consumers can own file uploads and insert their durable URL through that callback.
Toolbar requests use finite actions and can be controlled with onGenerate.
When bubbleMenu is enabled, a selection-driven Bold, Italic, Underline, and Link toolbar appears only for a nonempty selection and dismisses when the selection collapses.
The bubble menu is separate from the floating toolbar position.
accessibility: The editable content carries its name and form-like states.
Formatting actions expose named toggle buttons.
The color dialog and custom ColorField expose their names to assistive technology.
The selection formatting toolbar exposes named controls.

requirements.reason: Native colors do not apply to web React.
Native font metrics do not apply to web React.
